translation.name: Kalam Baybol Buk Gor minim nuk kisin angayak

book.name: Rom
book.title: ROM Pol Rom Biynimb Kuyip Minj Tikak.

content: Gor Kawnan Ak Gos Ñakniŋ Gi Dand Amiy Mey Perper Mindoniŋgambun
Pen chin Jiysis Krays biynimb nuk mindpun gok, Gor Kawnan ak gos ñakniŋ gon amek mey, tap siy tap timey giy kumbay ar ak kirpun. Krays yip mindpun kun ak, Gor chinup kor ma giniŋgamb.
Pen biynimb tep ma mindpun rek, Gor low ar ak gi dand amiy, mind tep ginjun rek ma ayek, Ñinuk key tap siy tap timey ma gip ak chinup nen aŋgiy, yokek apiy kumak.
Chinup nen kumak rek, Gor Kawnan gos ñimb ar anep giyiŋg, gos timey wip ar ak kirginiŋgambun. Pen nuk gos ñakniŋ, gi dand amyiŋg, low minim gunap ma timbrikniŋgambun.

Biynimb gos timey apek, ar kun ak gey amimb gok kumiy, am Gor yip ma mindeniŋgambay. Pen biynimb Gor Kawnan gos ñek gey amimb gok, Gor nup tep giniŋgamb ar anep gun aŋgiy, gipay ak mey; Gor yip jimñiy mindiy, mindrep giniŋgambay.
Biynimb gos kiyk keynep niŋiy gipay gok, Gor yip jimñiy ma mindpay. Kiyk biynimb nuk ma mindiy, aŋgip rek ma yimb gipay.
Biynimb kun gok mindrep gey, nup tep ginimuŋ rek ma ayip.
Pen nimb biynimb Gor Kawnan bak ayek yip mindpim gok, gos key niŋbim ar ak ma gipim; Gor Kawnan gos ñimb ar ak gipim. Biynimb Krays Kawnan yip ma mindpay gok, nup ker ma mindpay.
Pen gos timund nindnimb ak nuk yip kumek, suŋ-tep mindpim rek, gos yomb nimb ak amimb; Gor Kawnan gos ñimb ar ak.
Gor Ñinuk Krays nup gek tip tikjakak Kawnan ak dipim ak mey; nimbip kunep gek kim kisenimb ay, am nuk yip perper mindeniŋgambim.
Kun ak mam ay sikop. Chin yerginjun? Gos chinup ak key wip rek ginjun? Ak mer!
Ar kun ak gon amek, kumiy am Gor yip ma mindeniŋgambun. Pen Gor Kawnan ak gos ñakniŋ gon amek mey, Gor yip nep mindoniŋgambun.
Chin niŋbun: chin biynimb Gor Kawnan gos ñakniŋ girapun gok, ñapan nuk yimb mindpun.

Kun ak nind pirikyiŋgipun rek, Gor Kawnan ak chinup gos yerip rek ñiniŋgamb aŋgiy, jep diy, biynimb yikop woŋg giñemb rek ak ma mindonjun. Yenen; Kawnan nuk ak chin yip mindiy, gos ñakniŋ, ñapan nuk mindpun ak niŋrep giy, nup “Bapiy! Bapiy!” apun.

Kun ak ñapan nuk mindpun ak mey; Ñinuk Krays nup direp gip rek, chinup kunep giniŋgamb. Pen Krays nup aŋgjiwiy timey giyak rek, chinup kunep timey giniŋg gey ma pirikiy, Krays nup sakiy ma goniŋgambun; Ñinuk nup direp gak rek, chinup kunep giniŋgamb.
Kisen Mindrep Giniŋgambun
Yand niŋen: Krays nup chiŋgiy mindon miker gunap giniŋgamb ak, minim ma mindip. Ak yikop giniŋgamb. Am nuk yip mindrep giniŋgambun ñin ak, tep yimb giniŋgamb.

Tap gayak okok maŋgiysek, miñiy mindrep ginimuŋ rek ma ayip. Gip kun ak, Gor giniŋgamb aŋgak rek nep gip. Nuk aŋgak, “Tap gaynik gok gen, mindrep ma giy, gi dam dam kisen tip ak gen, mindrep giniŋgamb aŋgak.”
Tap gayak kun gok, nind mindrep ma giniŋgamb. Chinup biynimb gok gek ñapan nuk yimb ay, nuk yip mind tep giniŋgambun ñin ak nep; tap yikop kun gok gek mindrep giniŋgamb.
Chin niŋbun: tap Gor gayak kun gok maŋgiysek mindrep giniŋgamb ak pen; miñiy ñin biy, biyn ñapan tikniŋg gey yiwur gip rek ak gi mindip.
Pen nuk chinup pisnep diniŋg, Kawnan nuk yokek apiy yip mindpun gok kunep apun, “Ñin akay rek kim kisenimb ay, ñapan nuk yimb yipund giy mindeniŋgambun aŋgiy,” lum ar biy miker gakniŋ kond mindpun.

Nup chiŋgon chinup diniŋgamb aŋgiy, gos sek mindon mey, chinup dak. Pen ñin kun ak chinup pisnep dipkop ak; miñiy gos sek mindiy, ñin kisen ak ma kond mindombinup; pisnep kim kisenimb ay, mindombinup.
Pen chinup kisen direp giniŋgamb ak niŋiy mey, yiruk gakniŋ ma kond mindpun; gos sek kond mindpun.

Biynimb tep ma mindpun rek, Gor Kawnan ak chinup kond nep mindip. Chinup miker yimb gek, Gor nup aŋgniŋjun apun ak pen; minim yerip ak diy aŋgjun aŋgon, Kawnan nuk chinup kosyam aŋgep rek ayek niŋiy, Gor nup aŋgniŋimb.
Gor gos chin niŋbun ar gok maŋgiysek keykey niŋimb ak mey; Kawnan nuk ak miker chinup gip ak niŋiy aŋgniŋek, aŋgip rek gip. Yenen: Kawnan nuk aŋgniŋgamb ak, Gor giyn aŋgiy niŋimb ar anep aŋgniŋgamb.
Kun ak mey, Gor chinup diniŋg gek, nup gosimb niŋbun biynimb gok, kond mindakniŋ, tap gunap key ma giniŋgamb; nuk niŋek mindrep giniŋgambun ar anep chinup giniŋgamb.
Pen ar kun anep, Gor biynimb nuk diniŋg niŋak gok kuyip aŋgak, “Yand gen kiy Ñiyand Krays mindrep gip rek mindrep gey mey; numam nunay kisen nuk gok kuŋay yimb mindeniŋgambay aŋgak.”
Kun ak chinup diniŋg, suk aŋgek nup ker amon aŋgip, “Tap siy tap timey gipik ak niŋiy kirgispiyn. Kun ak yand yip jimñiy mindiy mey; yand bi tep kun ak key mindpiyn rek mindeniŋgambim aŋgip.”
Chinup Wasemb Ay Kond Mindrep Gip
Pen chinup kun giy direp gip ak, an chinup timey giniŋgamb? Mer yimb!
Gor nuk ma pirikiy, Ñinuk ak chinup nen aŋgiy yokek apiy kumak ak niŋbun: chinup kond mindek, mindrep yimb giniŋgambun.
Pen Gor gek suŋ-tep mindpun ak, an rek chinup kor giniŋgamb?
Bi kun ak rek bap ma mindpay. Nuk key Ñinuk nup aŋgek, ap chinup aŋgiy kumiy tikjakiy, am ñin yipund kind nuk okok ken mindiy, chinup nen Nop nup aŋgniŋ mindip.
Krays chinup wasemb yimb ayip ak, tap yerip ak gek jimñiy ma mindoniŋgambun?

content.text: Krays ker mindpay aŋgiy chinup timey giniŋgambay akaŋ,
ñaŋgniŋgambay akaŋ, tap yerip ak gek, Krays yip jimñiy ma mindoniŋgambun?

content: Minim kun ak rek Baybol buk ak tikiy aŋgyak:

content.text: “Nip ker mindpun rek, chinup niŋey, kanj siypsiyp tap gok rek ayek, ñaŋgayun aŋgiy nep niŋbay aŋgyak.”

content: Kun ak kumemb rek mindpun ak pen; Krays, bi chinup simb niŋiy kumak ak yip mindiy, tep gakniŋ nep mindpun.

Ar kun ak yand niŋrep yimb gipiyn; mindeniŋgambun akaŋ kumniŋgambun ak, Gor chinup wasemb aynep mindeniŋgamb. Tap bap chinup tuŋgasik key aynimuŋ rek ma ayip. Gor enjol nuk gok, Seytan kichekiy nuk gok, tap kalrimey gok, tap miñiy mindip gok, tap kisen mindeniŋgamb gok,
tap nukyoŋ mindip gok, tap nukyaŋ mindip gok, tap yerip yerip mindip okok maŋgiysek, tap bap chinup kun giniŋgiy rek ma ayip. Krays mindip rek, Gor chinup wasemb aynep mindeniŋgamb.
